ios.desc:
Taaly is a powerful language learning app that connects learners with native speakers through live one-on-one video chats—enabling any native speaker to become an effective practice partner fast, with real-time AI guidance. Whether you want to practice Dutch, coach Arabic, or learn English, Spanish, French, German, or other languages—Taaly makes it easy, meaningful, and fun.

Multilingual & Inclusive
No longer limited to Dutch, Taaly now supports multiple languages. Learn and coach in the language that matters most to you.

Become a Learner and a Coach
With Dual Role Accounts, you can both learn a new language and help others learn yours—switch roles anytime.

Karma Coins: Earn, Share, Learn
Taaly introduces Karma Coins, a fair and flexible credit system.
You earn coins by:

Creating your account

Completing your profile

Inviting friends

Attending practice conversations

Sharing feedback

Spend Karma Coins on practice conversations or redeem them soon for special gifts—or donate them to support other learners.

Smart Matching with AI
Our AI connects you with the right people based on shared interests, language level, and background—making every conversation more engaging and relevant.

Learn from Anywhere
No travel, no scheduling stress—Taaly brings the classroom to your phone. Perfect for families and individuals looking for flexible language support from home.

Whether you’re a learner looking to build confidence in speaking or a native speaker wanting to share your language and earn Karma Coins (or even real income), Taaly is your friendly, accessible solution for real conversations and real connection—with AI support to make it easier for everyone.

IT'S POSSIBLE WITH TAALY

Download now and join the growing Taaly community!

quotes.text:
Hey community,

I’m Shadi, a displaced founder who once crossed the desert to escape war—and later built Taaly, a language learning platform where learners practice 1-on-1 conversations with native speakers, guided by real-time AI feedback.

Unlike Duolingo or typical language schools, Taaly focuses on speaking—the skill most learners struggle to develop. We discovered that people learn best through conversation, but random chat apps weren't cutting it. So we added real-time AI guidance to help both the learner and the coach improve together.

Here’s what makes Taaly different:

Live, one-on-one video practice—no group classes or bots

Support for multiple languages (Dutch, Arabic, English, Spanish, French, German… more coming)

Dual-role accounts – coach in your language, learn a new one

Karma Coins – earn by helping, spend by learning. Buy if you want, earn if you contribute

Smart matching – AI pairs you based on interests, level, and background

We’re bootstrapped and growing. Just added:

AI guidance in live sessions

Learner-to-coach Karma Coin system

Profile-driven smart matches

Would love your feedback on:

Retention strategies for marketplace-style apps

Scaling the Karma Coin system

Ideas for growing trust in a peer-to-peer learning environment

You can try it here: https://www.taaly.nl/
Or check the Play Store listing here: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.language.taaly
